title: Coated in Drow Poison (Condition)
html:
Coated in Drow Poison

  • Targets must succeed a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or become  Poisoned and fall  Asleep.
  • On a successful save, targets receive  Inoculated: Drow Poison for 2 turns.

Properties

 Stack ID: DIPPED

 Status groups: SG_WeaponCoating

Condition: Stricken with Drow Poison

 Stricken with Drow Poison

 CON Save (DC 13)

  • Affected entity is  Poisoned and has fallen  Asleep.
  • Lasts until affected entity has made a successful  Constitution Saving Throw or takes damage.

Condition: Inoculated: Drow Poison

 Inoculated: Drow Poison

Duration: 2 turns

  • You succeeded on a  Saving Throw against  Drow Poison and can't be affected by it.

Sources of Coated in Drow Poison

  • Drow Poison

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID DIPPED, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Coated in Arsonist's Oil
  • Coated in an oil that strips targets that are Resistant to ⁠Fire damage of their Resistance.
  • Targets that are Immune to Fire damage are unaffected.
Coated in Basic Poison
  • Targets must succeed a  DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or become  Poisoned.
  • On a successful save, target receives Inoculated: Basic Poison for 2 turns.
Coated in Brewed-up Bellyglummer
  • Weapon is coated in Brewed-Up Bellyglummer. Targets must succeed a  DC 17 Constitution Saving Throw or become  Poisoned.
Coated in Crawler Mucus
  • Targets must succeed a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or become Stricken with Crawler Mucus.
  • On a successful save, targets receive Inoculated: Crawler Mucus for 2 turns
Coated in Diluted Oil of Sharpness
  • The arcane oil coating this weapon grants it a +1 bonus to Damage and  Attack Rolls. The weapon has become magical, so it can damage creatures that are immune to non-magical attacks.
Coated in Drow Poison
  • Targets must succeed a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or become  Poisoned and fall  Asleep.
  • On a successful save, targets receive Inoculated: Drow Poison for 2 turns.
Coated in Malice
  • Targets must succeed a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or become  Blinded and  Poisoned.
  • Targets that succeed the saving throw are granted the Inoculated: Malice condition for 2 turns.
Coated in Oil of Bane
  • Targets become  Baned for 2 turns unless they succeed a  DC 11 Charisma Saving Throw.
Coated in Oil of Combustion
  • Coated in flammable oil.
  • On a hit, the target is doused in oil for 2 turns. If it takes ⁠Fire damage, the oil immolates, dealing 3d6⁠⁠Fire damage in an area around it.
Coated in Oil of Diminution
  • Targets must succeed a  DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw or receive  Disadvantage on  Strength Checks and  Strength Saving Throws, as well as a -1d4 penalty to damage on melee attacks for 2 turns.
Coated in Oil of Freezing
  • Targets receive  Encrusted with Frost for 2 turns.
Coated in Purple Worm Toxin
  • Targets take 1d10⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a  DC 19 Constitution Saving Throw.
Coated in Serpent Venom Toxin
  • Targets take 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a  DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw.
Coated in Toxin
  • Targets take 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a  DC 11 Constitution Saving Throw.
Coated in Wizardsbane Oil
  • Severely dampens the power of any spellcaster struck with this weapon.
  • Targets receive a -3 penalty to spell  Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC, and  Disadvantage on  Saving Throws for maintaining Concentration for 2 turns.
Coated in Wyvern Toxin
  • Targets take 1d8⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw.
Dipped in Fire
  • Weapon deals additional 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage.
Dipped in Poison
  • Weapon deals additional 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage.
